notes.title: Release Notes - September 12 Patch
notes.content:
We're excited to bring you the latest update with new features and important fixes to enhance your gameplay!

New Features:
Support for Incremental Time Control Modes: You can now play with incremental time controls, adding a new dynamic to your chess games. Enjoy more flexible time management during matches!
Fixes and Improvements:
Various Bug Fixes and Improvements: We've addressed several bugs and made performance improvements for a smoother and more enjoyable gaming experience.
Update now to enjoy these new features and improvements! Happy gaming!

notes.title: August 27 Patch
notes.content:
We're excited to bring you the latest update, featuring new customization options and important fixes to enhance your gaming experience!

New Features:
Supports Changing Game Interface Language via Steam Settings: You can now easily change the game's interface language directly through Steam's game settings. Customize your experience in the language of your choice.
Fixes and Improvements:
Game Controller Issue Fix: We've resolved an issue where some game settings couldn't be changed when using a game controller. Your settings adjustments should now work seamlessly.
Update now to enjoy these new features and improvements! Happy gaming!

notes.title: June 22 Patch
notes.content:
We're excited to bring you the latest update, featuring new game options, a challenging AI level, and essential improvements to enhance your gaming experience!

New Features:
Supports Underpromotion: You can now underpromote your pawns to knights, bishops, or rooks.

New AI Level 6: Introducing our new AI Level 6, providing an even more challenging and competitive experience for advanced players.

Play from Custom Positions in Board Editor: Create and play from custom positions using our enhanced Board Editor. Explore different scenarios and improve your strategy.

Fixes and Improvements:
Bug Fixes and Performance Enhancements: We've addressed various bugs and made performance improvements to ensure a smoother and more enjoyable gaming experience.
Update now to enjoy these new features and improvements! Happy gaming!

notes.title: June 5 Patch
notes.content:
We're excited to bring you the latest update, featuring new game modes, themes, and essential improvements to enhance your gaming experience!

New Features:
Exciting New Chess Puzzle Mode: Dive into our new Chess Puzzle Mode, offering over 7000 chess puzzles sourced from famous and high-level chess games. Unlock several game achievements for solving puzzles and showcase your strategic prowess.

Multiple New Plain Color Themes: Customize your game with new plain color themes. Choose your favorite colors to create a more personalized and visually pleasing experience.

Fixes and Improvements:
Bug Fixes and Performance Improvements: We've addressed various bugs and made performance enhancements to ensure a smoother and more enjoyable gaming experience.
Update now to enjoy these new features and improvements! Happy gaming!

notes.title: May 31 Patch
notes.content:
May 31 Patch
We're excited to bring you the latest update, packed with new achievements, important fixes, and improvements to enhance your gaming experience!

New Features:
Over 35 New Achievements: Earn achievements when you play Chess games featuring famous openings like Ruy Lopez, as well as fun openings such as The Bongcloud. Challenge yourself and collect them all!
Fixes and Improvements:
Steam Integration Fixes on Mac OSX: We have resolved issues related to Steam integration on Mac OSX. Enjoy a smoother and more reliable experience on your Mac.

Display Steam Player Name: Your Steam player name is now displayed when playing against computer opponents. Personalize your matches and see your name in action.

Enhanced AI Bot: The AI bot is now more fun to play with, offering a more engaging and challenging experience. Test your skills and enjoy smarter gameplay.

Update now to enjoy these new features and improvements! Happy gaming!

notes.title: May 29 Patch
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce the latest update to our game, introducing new features to enhance your gaming experience!

New Features:
Game Controller Support: Enjoy a more immersive gaming experience with full support for game controllers. Play with your favorite controller for more precise and comfortable gameplay.

SteamDeck Compatibility: Our game is now fully optimized for SteamDeck. Take your gaming on the go and enjoy smooth, seamless performance on your SteamDeck device.

Update now to take advantage of these new features and enjoy a more versatile gaming experience! Happy gaming!

notes.title: May 28 Patch
notes.content:
We're excited to announce the latest update to our app, packed with new features to enhance your gaming experience!

New Features:
Steam Achievements: Unlock and track your progress with our newly integrated Steam achievements. Show off your skills and milestones to your friends and the gaming community.

Leaderboards: Compete with players worldwide! Our new Steam leaderboards feature lets you see how you rank against other players in various game modes.

Steam Cloud Synchronization: Seamlessly sync your preferences and saved games between devices. Never lose your progress and enjoy a consistent gaming experience wherever you go.

Update now to enjoy these exciting new features and elevate your gaming experience to the next level! Happy gaming!
